events.title: The Mystery Mist Confirmed to Join Chinese New Year Steam Event
events.summary: Dear players, We're happy to announce that we're joining the Chinese New Year celebration event. Sorry to keep you all waiting for the full version of the game and for the radio silence regarding the development. Believe us, we're working hard on getting everything ready for The Grand Release, stay tuned! We hope you are as excited as we are for the official release and we wish you a wonderful Year of the Snake!
